title: the web server's ground-loop pulse starts its listener windowless on Windows whatever its own interpreter
intention: On Windows the web server's pulse starts the listener through background_pythonw, so a silent port 80 never opens a console window; off Windows the argv is unchanged.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendell: the visible console windows were venv python3.exe launchers spawned with detached_kwargs; heartbeat.spawn_pulses was one (ticket 8c829d9b38b8). pulse.ensure at cairn/devices/web_server/groundloop/pulse.py:143 has the same shape: `python: str = sys.executable` reaches _detached under detached_kwargs, so a silent port starts the listener as a python.exe console. HYPOTHESIS (Law 3): the shape is read in source, not yet measured as a window; the proof must red first.
traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8 (measured, with a proof a hollow build could not pass); outline 10.3.2.1; Akien 2026-11-23 via the orchestrator: akiendell is still throwing up windows as it goes.
how: pulse.ensure defaults its python to windowless_spawn.background_pythonw() instead of sys.executable (an explicit python argument still wins); a red-first proof starts the listener on a scratch port and reads the spawned tree and the visible ConsoleWindowClass windows with EnumWindows.

clauses.claim: on Windows ensure() on a silent scratch port starts a listener tree holding no python.exe, no conhost.exe and no visible console window
off Windows the listener argv[0] is still sys.executable
an explicit python argument is used as given, and a held port spawns nothing

decisions.text: D1: ensure's python default becomes background_pythonw(); nothing else in pulse.py changes.
D2: the proof starts the listener on a scratch port with unit=None and reads the tree (CIM) and visible console windows (EnumWindows); one tooth per clause, each UNRAN on the host that cannot run it.

measured.saw: visible ConsoleWindowClass windows were venv python3.exe launchers spawned detached (pulse.py, started by heartbeat.spawn_pulses); the same call shape stands in this site's source.
measured.how: EnumWindows poller at 20-40 ms over two runs of about 350 s on akiendell; source read of cairn/devices/web_server/groundloop/pulse.py
